t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone background. Eyebrow and wordmark over a hairline rule. Left: an oversized light-weight navy sans headline stacked over four lines. Right: a hairline-framed panel with an isometric navy line drawing of twin process trains, uniform strokes, no shading. Across the bottom, a deep navy strip holding five square white cards with large mono numerals, uppercase titles, short notes and bracketed mono codes for <CONTENT>; one card filled steel blue. Square corners, flat.
signature_idea: A huge stacked headline and a framed twin-train line drawing sit over a band of five numbered redundancy cards, one lit in steel blue.
strengths: oversized light headline and isometric line drawing are strong and on-brand
card band with mono numerals and codes is a reusable options pattern
one steel-blue card is a disciplined single accent
clear hierarchy from headline to drawing to options
weaknesses: duplicated card 02 floats over the layout and overlaps the headline
headline is not cropped as the brief asked, so less dramatic
drawn tanks look like stainless vessels rather than PP modules
bracketed codes are invented and read like real part numbers
brand_fit_why: Light oversized headline, line drawing, mono codes and one steel-blue card fit, but the duplicated floating card and garbled text break the calm.
